findings.unchanged: Dimensions, convolution stride/padding and operation order, dynamic quantization, normalization, attention scalar loops, GELU, output argmax, CTC/text and Rayon available_parallelism.min(4) policy.
findings.intentional: Cancellation checkpoints and Result propagation, parallel for_each to fallible try_for_each over independent output rows, tiny XNET header rejection. Q/K/V matrix operations remain in the same order with intervening cancellation checks.

findings.unchanged: PREV=200, BLK=400, POST=100, PAD=50, WHOLE_MAX=2000; stream window boundaries, blank-tail truncation, CTC/tidy punctuation rules, full-sequence final decode for <=2000 feature frames.
findings.intentional: Cancellation checks and accepted-nonzero gate; exact-zero sessions suppress model partial/final decode.

findings.unchanged: Quantization, f32 dot, output scaling/bias arithmetic; iteration/write helper refactor preserves output cells and scalar operation order.
findings.intentional: Stable NEON signed widening products replace unstable vdot intrinsic; AVX2 signed i8 widening replaces maddubs/sign approach to correctly handle -128. Native ARM/x86 optimized outputs were checked against independent i64 sums by the separate native-runner evidence.
findings.limit: Fixed model weight distribution has not been audited for -128. The AVX2 repair may intentionally change output relative to the original buggy AVX2 path. Native scalar equivalence is not a complete upstream model token comparison.

findings.upstream: The engine drains already queued PCM via try_recv before considering a partial decode.
findings.adapter: The worker considers a partial after each accepted frame, while retaining all queued frames and using the same fresh>=30 / previous-cost*3 gate.
findings.implication: Unpaced input can produce more partial computations and different preview timing, affecting compute cost/latency. Partial output is not fed back into model or committed token state. Short final sequences are recomputed in full; this source review cannot attribute poor short-fixture CER to partial scheduling. No product scheduling change was made.

limits: No actual licensed weights were available in this local review, and no local full-model inference was run.
No upstream-versus-adapter scalar/full-model token or transcript parity has been executed.
Source review and cloud kernel parity do not establish natural speech recognition quality or a handset recommendation.

Agreement between ARM/x86 on one fixed synthetic PCM, if separately observed, establishes cross-architecture agreement for that sample only; it does not establish upstream-reference parity or natural speech quality.
The incomplete final Fbank window retains upstream snip-edges behavior; no tail-flush quality change was introduced.
Only evidence documents were added for this review; no runtime source, corpus, model, product defaults or CI was changed.
possible_follow_up: After the current Alpha model gates, an isolated offline-only harness can compile pinned upstream model/stream with a scalar kernel reference and compare feature frames, token IDs and transcripts on the identical locked PCM/model. No cloud client crate is required. This has not been implemented or executed.
